text:
aria: Heads-up: scheduling a rolling maintenance for APAC provisioning cluster `apac-prov-2` next Tue 00:30 UTC (90m window). Goal: pool-manager v2.4.1 deploy + restart node-agent on compute nodes to pick up driver config.

aria: Expected impact: scheduling delays (~30-120s) while pool-manager restarts and node-agents re-register. Running inference should continue on already scheduled pods, but new task placement may be delayed briefly. No GPU reboots planned.

mike: Which pools are in scope? any dedicated/reserved pools?

aria: Scope: ephemeral and spot-backed pools in apac1 only. Dedicated/reserved pools are excluded. We'll set a `dedicated-safe` flag in the ticket.

sasha: Ops note: node-agent restarts can temporarily remove nodes from scheduler until re-register; recommend cohort size 10% of pool and 6m stagger. Add prewarm backfill to avoid cold starts.

aria: Plan: cohorts of 5 nodes (approx 10%); stagger 360s; after each cohort run `prov-warmup --kv 600 --sched-seed 300`. Abort criteria: >5% task placement failures or p95 scheduling latency > 2s for 10m.

liam: I'll run a placement synthetic and watch scheduling p95. Canary after cohort2 for 15m. If p95 > 2s or placement fails > 3% we pause.

felix: Support: status page and enterprise comms drafted. We'll send 6h pre-alert to APAC customers and include PSAT about Dedicated unaffected. Prepare inbound ticket template.

nina: Cost note: if scheduler falls back to cross-region placement we might see inter-region egress for control RPCs and temporary burst of preemptible capacity in us-east. Rough estimate: ~$800 extra over the window worst-case. Call it out in comms.

aria: Runbook snippet:
```
prov-cordon --cluster apac-prov-2 --pool ephemeral --cohort 5
prov-restart-agent --grace 120
prov-warmup --kv 600 --sched-seed 300
prov-verify --checks registration,sched-latency,backfill
```

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-3580 created and scheduled. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/provisioner-maint. Paging: eng-infra-oncall.

mike: Who's on-call for the window? Need SRE + scheduler owner.

liam: ACK (sre/scheduler). I'll be on-call and will post canary link 30m before start.

felix: ACK (support). PSAT and status page queued.

sasha: ACK (ops). I'll coordinate stagger automation.

aria: Thanks  If canary looks good we'll proceed. Will post final go/no-go 20m prior. Ping this thread for any blockers.

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-3580 state -> scheduled. Notifying eng-infra-oncall.

aria: Quick reminder in comms: "No GPU reboots, dedicated pools unaffected, possible short scheduling delays for new tasks in apac1".

liam: Also adding a temporary autoscaler buffer + backfill policy for the window to reduce placement timeouts. I'll document params in ticket.

nina: Adding cost tag and post-op checklist to ticket. We'll run cost delta report after.

aria: Final ack list: liam (SRE), sasha (ops), felix (support), mike (infra). If no objections I'll mark ticket scheduled.

mike: ACK.

aria: Marking scheduled. Will post post-op summary within 24h.
